dus deb dang tshags par la lta klog mang tsam byed dgos par ma zad/dmangs khrod kyi glu dang gtam dpe/ sgrung gtam sogs 'tshol sdud byed pa'i bya 'gul la zhugs te/ rang nyid kyi rtsom 'bri'i nus pa mthor 'degs su gtong bar rmang gzhi brtan po zhig bskrun dgos/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'tshol sdud byed pa de slob chung slob ma zhig la mtshon na rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi gom pa dang po yin/ slob mas dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'tshol sdud byed pa brgyud de rang nyid kyi lta rgya dang thos rgya je cher btang na/ ca rtsom rig gsar rtsom khrod kyi bsam gzhig gi nus pa 'don spel byed pa dang mnyam du/ don dag ci zhig tshul ji ltar du 'bri rgyu yin pa'i bsam blo 'khor srid pas brjod bya mi rnyed pa'i dka' ngal yang rim bzhin sel thub pa red/gnyis pa/ 'od byed tshig gi dka' ngal/slob chung slob mas rtsom yig 'bri dus skad cha ci zhig tshul ji ltar du bshad pa dang / don dag de yi ge'i lam nas ji ltar 'bri bar dus tshod ha cang ring po zhig la bsam blo gtong dgos pa red/ slob grogs 'ga' rer brjod bya yod rung 'bri rgyu ci yang mi rnyed pa de la rjod byed tshig gi dka' ngal zer/ slob chung slob mar mtshon na rjod byed tshig gi 2

slob 'bring slob ma'i rtsom yig 'bri sbyong gi dga' snang ji ltar gar skul byed pa'i skor rags tsam gleng ba/mtsho sngon mtsho lho khul/ 'ba' gdugs lhe rtsom yig slob khrid ni slob 'bring slob ma'i skad yig slob khrid kyi dka' gnad yin zhing / rtsom yig 'bri sbyong ni slob ma'i skad yig gi rmang gzhi la zhib bsher byed pa'i lag cha gtso bo zhig yin/ de bas slob 'bring slob ma'i skad yig dge rgan zhig yin tshe/ nges par du slob ma'i blo kha rtsom yig 'bri sbyong gi phyogs su bsgyur ba dang chabs cig tu slob ma'i rtsom yig 'bri sbyong gi dga' snang yar skul byed par shugs snon byed dgos/dang po/ slob ma'i rtsom yig la zur za dang mthong chung byed mi rung /rtsom yig 'bri ba ni gsar btod rang bzhin gyi ngal rtsol zhig yin 5

ma bkod na slob ma'i rgyud la nga rgyal skye srid/(gnyis pa)rtsom yig bris pa cung zhan pa'i slob mar ci nus gang thub kyis kho'i rtsom yig gi bzang cha 'god dgos pa ste/ ming re 'ga' bkol pa legs pa'am/ tshig re 'ga' bsgrigs pa gson nyams ldan pa/tha na rtsom yig gi ngos gtsang ba dang yig 'bru gral dag pa sogs kyi cha la'ang bsngags brjod byas te skul ma gtong dgos/ rtsom yig gi zhan cha'i skor la dpyad brjod nyung tsam nas rim gyis je mang du gtong ba ma gtogs/ zhan cha mang bo gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis bkod na slob ma'i rgyud la gnon shugs che bar ma zad/ rtsom yig ye nas 'bri mi 'dod pa zhig tu'ang 'gyur srid/gsum pa/ gzhan rtsom gyi legs cha bsdu ba dang lad blos kyis 'bri bar skul ma gtong dgos/slob ma rnams la spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i nyams myong dang bya dngos kyi ngos 'dzin nus pa/ gsar btod kyi nus pa sogs cung zhan pas/dge rgan gyis rtsom yig 'bri tshul ji 'dra mang bo zhig brjod kyang slob ma'i blo ngor gsal bo zhig 'jags dka'/ dper na/ rtswa thang mthong ma myong ba'i mi zhig la rtswa thang ni rtswa yi thang ste g.yu mdog gi mdangs 7

slob chung slob ma'i rtsom 'bri'i spro snang dzi ltar skyed sring byed pa'i skor mdo tsam brjod pa/mtsho sngon thun rin rdzong / bsod nams mtsho slob chung slob mas rtsom yig 'bri skabs rgyun par 'bri rgyu mi rnyed pa dang / bris kyang brjod bya'i snying bo mi gsal ba dang rjod byed kyi tshig 'brel mi chags pa sogs kyi gnad don byung dang 'byung mus mchis/ slob ma'i rtsom 'bri'i nus pa je mthor gtong 'dod na/ nges par du rtsom yig 'bri ba'i spro snang skyed sring byed pa nas mgo brtsam dgos/dang po/ ri mor bltas te skad cha smyong brdar byed pa nas rim bzhin rtsom 'bri'i spro snang skyed sring byed dgos/skad cha ni yi ge'i rmang gzhi yin la/ yi ge ni skad cha legs bcos dang 'phel rgyas byung ba las thon pa zhig yin pas/ rtsom yig yag po 9
